def main():
    try:
        payload = run(sys.argv[1:])
    except Fatal as exc:
        sys.stderr.write('ipv6_replay: error: %s\n' % (exc,))
        return 2
    except Exception as exc:                      # never write partial stdout
        sys.stderr.write('ipv6_replay: error: %s: %s\n'
                         % (type(exc).__name__, exc))
        return 2
    try:
        stream = getattr(sys.stdout, 'buffer', None)
        if stream is None:                          # unusual stdout wrapper
            sys.stdout.write(payload)
            sys.stdout.flush()
        else:
            stream.write(payload.encode('utf-8'))
            stream.flush()
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        sys.stderr.write('ipv6_replay: error: cannot write stdout: %s\n' % (exc,))
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
